Nvidia Reportedly Can Ship Only 1% of Chinese RTX Orders

China wants Nvidia chips. Nvidia can’t make enough.
Chinese AI and cloud firms, including Alibaba Group, Tencent Holdings and ByteDance, have ordered about 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips, according to Bloomberg. 

They expect to receive only some tens of thousands, roughly 1%, over the next four months.
The reason, per the report: Nvidia is struggling to boost production to meet soaring demand.

That’s a supply gap, not a demand problem. The article doesn’t say when production might catch up, or give a comment from Nvidia.

Is the bottleneck production, policy or both? And who fills the gap for Chinese AI developers while they wait?
